checks.notes: A definite static flow fails. Regex absence cannot prove end-to-end non-flow and remains unmeasured; evidence never includes values or call text.
checks.rule: A PII-bearing identifier must not reach console, network or direct share sinks outside an export-controlled delivery function.
checks.title: PII flow to unapproved sinks

checks.notes: Names such as token, SaagarExportControl or beginDelivery do not authorize a sink unless the control is invoked and denial returns or throws before delivery.
checks.rule: Every reachable download, print, popup, browser share or native share delivery must have a structural fail-closed begin-delivery guard, or be a helper whose every call site has that guard.
checks.title: Export policy bypass

checks.rule: An authentication, authorization or PIN control must deny when its required control is absent or throws.
checks.title: Fail-open authentication and PIN controls

checks.notes: The report emits only rule identifier, file, line and one-way fingerprint; suspected values are never emitted.
checks.rule: Every tracked nonbinary text file must be bounded-scanned for private keys, secret-bearing files and high-confidence credential formats.
checks.title: Tracked secret scan

checks.notes: Block comments, licence-only URLs, SVG namespaces, data/blob URLs, localhost and approved literals are excluded.
checks.rule: Shipped runtime must not contain a reachable literal external request, remote asset, navigation or message target outside approved contexts; dynamic targets must be resolved before pass.
checks.title: Unapproved remote runtime behavior
